# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is described as fat.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is sulky, disagreeable, and known as the sharpest-tongued young lady at Queen's. She is prone to peeping in her book during spelling exercises and boasts rather more than good taste permits when victorious. She is quick to make blunt and mocking remarks about others, including calling Anne a perfect scarecrow and mocking her hair.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea school, where she once peeped in her book during a spelling class. During a game of dares with her schoolmates, she successfully walked the Barrys' board fence with airy unconcern after Anne Shirley dared her. When preparing for a school concert, she was sulky because she did not get the role of the fairy queen in a dialogue. At the Exhibition, she earned first prize for her knitted lace. She joined the Queen's class, stating she was going to college for education's sake because she would not have to earn her own living. While at Queen's Academy, she earned a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student. She was the final member of the Pye family to pass through the Avonlea school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
